description: This file contains JavaScript functions for managing portal sites in the vtiger CRM system, including fetching, saving, deleting sites, and URL handling.

methods.name: fetchAddSite
methods.description: Fetches and displays a form or data to add a new portal site by its ID.

methods.name: fetchContents
methods.description: Loads portal content based on the specified mode, either reloading the page or updating content via AJAX.

methods.name: DeleteSite
methods.description: Deletes a portal site after user confirmation, identified by its ID.

methods.name: SaveSite
methods.description: Validates and saves portal site data via AJAX, updating the interface accordingly.

methods.name: setSite
methods.description: Sets the source of an iframe or element to the selected portal site URL.

methods.name: defaultMysites
methods.description: Sets a default portal site based on user selection via AJAX.

methods.name: OnUrlChange
methods.description: Handles URL input change, removing protocol prefix if present.
